name: UI UX Pro Max Skill
hook: 127k-star design system generator that turns Claude Code into a senior product designer: 79 UI styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, and 22 tech stacks (React, Vue, Tailwind, iOS, Android, and more). Analyzes your project and auto-generates a complete design system with typography, colors, and anti-patterns to avoid. Never appeared in this digest.
install: npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli && uipro init --ai claude

name: Hermes Agent
hook: 245k-star self-improving AI agent from Nous Research — the largest agent framework on GitHub, crossing 100K stars faster than any prior framework. Every 15 tool calls it pauses, extracts what worked, and saves a new skill file; persistent memory and cross-session identity make it compound over time. Notably ships a claude-code SKILL.md so Hermes can delegate to Claude Code as a subagent. Available on Telegram, Discord, Slack, CLI, and more.

name: CC Switch
hook: 132k-star cross-platform desktop app (Tauri 2 + Rust) that manages provider configs, MCP servers, and Skills across seven AI coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, and Claude Desktop — from a single interface. Hit 104K stars in June, now at 132K; 149 contributors, 41 releases. Never appeared in this digest.

name: i-have-adhd
hook: 44k stars (+900 in 24h) for this 10-rule output-reformatter skill: action first, steps numbered, no filler preamble. Viral on Threads (40k+ impressions) and still climbing. Deceptively simple — installs in 30 seconds and immediately changes how Claude structures every response.

name: Archify
hook: 60.4k stars (+1.1k in 24h) for the code-to-interactive-architecture-diagram skill. v2.17.0-dev.1 active in development; supports Architecture Delta (before/after snapshots), 5 diagram types, themed SVG/HTML export, and semantic lens for role comparison. Still posting its strongest weekly growth.

name: trace-mcp
hook: MCP server that achieves a median 72.7% token reduction on PR review workloads, validated across 60 real PRs. Ships with a benchmark harness so teams can verify the reduction on their own repos before adopting. 175 stars and growing.

name: Spotify portal-ai-plugins / shunt
hook: 1.5k-star hooks plugin from Spotify Engineering that intercepts bulk file reads and routes them to a cheap model, achieving up to 90% token reduction. Described in the Spotify Engineering blog as production-tested on their internal Claude Code rollout.

name: Claude Code Function Hooks
hook: TypeScript module hooks gated behind CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 (shipped in build 2.1.260), now in active community feedback on issue #91870. Lets you intercept and modify any tool call — pre/post Bash, file reads, MCP calls — from pure TypeScript without a subprocess.

name: ralph-wiggum (Anthropic official plugin)
hook: Official Anthropic plugin (v1.0.0, authored by Daisy Hollman) implementing a stop-hook loop: Claude stops, ralph-wiggum evaluates whether the task is truly done, and re-queues it if not — achieving persistent task execution without user babysitting. Ships as a first-party plugin in the claude-code repo.

name: Claude Code Smart Reports
hook: Enterprise beta launched September 11: analyzes team usage patterns, costs, friction points, and surfaces reusable skill candidates from your org's Claude Code sessions. Available on Claude Enterprise plans via the admin dashboard.

name: Zilliz Claude Context
hook: 11.9k-star MCP that adds hybrid BM25+vector semantic code search to Claude Code — find the right file or function even when you don't know its exact name. Built on Milvus; indexes incrementally so cold starts are fast.

name: browser-act/skills
hook: 5.3k-star browser automation CLI skills for AI agents — anti-bot bypass, parallel session management, and headless Chrome control baked into a skills layer that Claude Code can invoke directly. Fills the gap between Playwright raw API and an agent-friendly skill interface.

name: Claude Code Best Practice
hook: 65.9k stars for this single CLAUDE.md file distilling Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls into actionable agent-engineering rules. Currently the #1 repo on the claude-code-skills GitHub topic.

name: video-shotcraft
hook: 8.4k-star cinematic product video skill: 152 shot recipe cards and 209 motion previews for generating polished Remotion videos from Claude Code. Each recipe card maps a product type to a shot sequence, lens choice, and color grade — no video editing background required.

name: mattpocock/skills
hook: 260.1k stars (+8.8k this week) — real-world TypeScript educator workflow skills from Matt Pocock (Total TypeScript). Covers the patterns teams actually hit: module resolution, type narrowing edge cases, and library authoring. Still gaining ~1.2k stars/day.
